reason: Free ChatGPT and NotebookLM already struggle with my 150-slide decks, so paying 49,000 VND ($1.90) once via VietQR—with no $20/month auto-renewal and a timer that stays paused until Exam Week—is cheap enough for me to try right after testing one real PDF for free.
objection: I'm skeptical it can accurately handle messy mixed English/Vietnamese slides without subtle formula mistakes like other AI tools, since a refund won't save my grade 48 hours before a midterm, and the whole 'Arena Sprint Mode' and 'Contender' framing feels cluttered when I just want fast cram notes.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 1-PDF preview botched a formula from my own lecture slides, or if it required a recurring subscription instead of one-time VietQR.
